title: Learning to Rank: Pointwise, Pairwise & Listwise
interviewAnswer: Learning-to-rank objectives optimize ordering rather than only class labels. Pointwise treats items independently, pairwise compares preferences, and listwise objectives model the ranked list more directly.
keyPoints: Training objective should align with ranking metric.
why: Learning to Rank: Pointwise, Pairwise & Listwise is a recurring foundation across data science and machine learning because it affects both theoretical correctness and practical system behavior.
intuition: Training objective should align with ranking metric.
